Pregnancy guidance differs by product, so check which cyclobenzaprine product you use.

Because neural tube development happens early, often before pregnancy is recognized, avoid Tonmya during this window. Your healthcare provider should do a pregnancy test before you start Tonmya, and you should use effective contraception during treatment and for two weeks after the final dose. 3
